title: Contact
description: How to get in touch with Guidelark about corrections, questions and article ideas.
body:
The best way to reach {{siteName}} is by email:

**[{{email}}](mailto:{{email}})**

## What to write about

- **Corrections.** If a number or fact looks wrong, please include the article link and what you think it should be.
- **Questions.** I read everything. I cannot give personal financial advice, but reader questions often become articles.
- **Topic requests.** Tell me what you are trying to figure out.

Replies usually take a few days.
